title: Unifont-T font pack
description: Unifont-T for Chinese Traditional (Taiwan). Unifont T源版繁中字型。
body:
![置中標點 | 台標字形 | 宋體風格](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7df9d763f6f2e4a79f6b2573c3dd9b94da2e0d5.gif)

Adds the [GNU Unifont](https://unifoundry.com/unifont/index.html) T-source Chinese version, which uses Taiwanese-style glyphs, including centered punctuation.  
新增[GNU Unifont](https://unifoundry.com/unifont/index.html) T源繁體中文版，大致遵循國字標準字體，包括置中標點符號。

This pack only contains glyphs unique to Unifont-T (i.e., it doesn't contain glyphs that are identical in both Unifont-T and the standard Unifont).  
本字型包僅收錄與原版不同的T源字形。

This pack only affects when "Japanese Glyph Variants" is OFF.  
需將「日文字形變體」設為「關閉」才能顯示本包字型。

The current Unifont version is `17.0.05` (same as `17.0.04` for T-source).  
Unifont最新版本為`17.0.05`（T源部分與`17.0.04`相同）。
